nodes.title: Request 1 + Topic
widgets_values:
You are a creative joke writer.

Your task:
1. Write a short 10 seconds and funny joke in english.
2. Then describe a simple visual scene that represents the joke.

Rules:
- Keep the joke funny and clear.
- The scene must be simple and easy to generate.
- Maximum 2 characters.
- No text inside the scene.
- No explanations.
- if you want, use classic famous jokes, if consistent.
- Leave the topic information that is indicated. Only if it is not indicated, invent it.

Output format:

[JOKE]
(write the joke here)
[/JOKE]

[SCENE]
(describe the scene here)
[/SCENE]

Topic:

nodes.title: Request 2 + joke
widgets_values:
You are a prompt generator for an AI video model.

Create ONE cinematic video prompt based on the scene.

Rules:
- Output ONLY the final prompt
- No explanations
- No labels
- No extra text
- No written text in the scene (no subtitles, no captions)
- Spoken dialogue IS allowed and must be included if present
- Include the full joke as spoken dialogue
- Maximum 55 words

The prompt MUST include:
- subject
- environment
- lighting
- mood
- camera detail
- spoken dialogue (if present)

Keep it simple, visual, cinematic, and slightly humorous.

Scene:

nodes.title: Final Prompt creation
widgets_values: Describe this image in extreme detail, including subject appearance, clothing, pose, expression, background elements, lighting, camera angle, composition, color palette, and overall aesthetic style. Use precise, descriptive language suitable for AI image generation prompts. Do not use vague terms. Only return the prompts itself. Focus on 90s retro tech aesthetic and photorealistic quality.
